decisions.reason: Changing the panel-input bias resistors to 3.3V pull-ups does not alter the AXP2101 battery/USB power-path requirements. The separate VBACKUP test-pad request concerns RTC backup access rather than the candidate's existing main power-path state.

The panel-button pull-up change does not modify the sensor-board connector inventory or module interfaces. The PIR and touch statements explicitly confirm their existing pull-down behavior and require no change.
